verdict: No strategy is active. Nothing cleared the sealed test, so the signal path is unchanged. A rule that only works on the data it was chosen on is not a strategy, and shipping one would cost real money rather than merely being wrong on paper.
howToEarnAPlace: Clear |t| > 3.75 on the sealed 25% (a bar corrected for 288 hypotheses) and beat the random-entry 95th percentile at matched trade count.
